tasks_completed.description: Canonicalize mcp_client.py: ensure __enter__/__exit__, fix stale-attribute bug in __exit__, make package optional for AC4 lifecycle smoke test
tasks_completed.changes: (a) __init__: changed signature from `package: str` to `package: Optional[str] = None` so the AC4 spec test `MCPClient()` constructs without args. All existing call-sites pass package positionally and continue to work. (b) __exit__: previous body referenced `self._proc` which never existed (canonical attribute is `self.process`), so cleanup was silently a no-op. New __exit__ delegates to the existing close() method which uses self.process correctly. (c) No duplicate copies of scripts/lib/mcp_client.py exist — the per-skill copies under .claude/commands/scripts/<skill>/scripts/mcp_client.py are skill-local executables, not duplicates of the canonical lib copy, and are out of W3 scope.
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec Section 5.2 plan item 4 + AC4: the persistence layer / image-fetch lifecycle needs a working context manager. The pre-existing __exit__ was dead code (wrong attribute name); the AC4 spec test required no-arg construction.

tasks_completed.changes: (a) Added StockImageRejected exception subclass of JSONIOError. (b) Added module-level _STOCK_IMAGE_DOMAINS tuple containing the 6 spec-mandated stock providers (images.unsplash.com, picsum.photos, placeholder.com, via.placeholder.com, loremflickr, placekitten). (c) Added _check_payload_for_stock_urls + _check_payload_for_http_image_url + _reject_unsafe_image_payloads helpers. (d) Wired _reject_unsafe_image_payloads into save_agent_json AFTER schema validation but BEFORE atomic write. (e) Wired the same rejector into _batch_write_tmp so save_agent_batch is also covered. The check is intentionally string-based (json.dumps + substring/regex) so it catches stock URLs anywhere in the payload, not just on a specific field. key=AIzaSy URLs are NOT matched and pass through (user-accepted per spec 5.1).
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec Section 5.2 plan item 4 + AC4: the spec requires NEW writes to be permanently blocked when they contain stock-image URLs or http:// image_url scheme, while preserving the user-accepted current state for existing key=AIzaSy URLs. Section 5.1 explicitly says NOT to reject key=AIzaSy.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Multi-cycle accretion (cycles 20260505-123425/-174743/E1-E10); not a single regression
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: 1) gaode-maps poi_search.py was relocated from .claude/skills/ to .claude/commands/scripts/ but the image-fetcher's two callsites were never updated, and the surrounding try/except quietly absorbed the FileNotFoundError. 2) An earlier mcp_client refactor renamed `self._proc` to `self.process` but missed the __exit__ branch that still referenced the stale name, leaving cleanup as silent dead code. 3) The persistence layer never had a stock-image / http:// guard, so the dual write paths through fetch-images-batch.py and save.py could leak unsplash/picsum URLs into trip JSONs.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: 1) The path literals are now correct, so subprocess invocations resolve and the silent except-pass no longer hides the bug. 2) __exit__ now routes through close() which uses the canonical self.process attribute, and package is optional so the AC4 lifecycle smoke test works without simulating a real MCP server. 3) The persistence rejector lives at the validate-and-atomic-write boundary in save_agent_json + _batch_write_tmp, so any future agent or script that writes through json_io is automatically gated against stock URLs and http:// image_url scheme. The user-accepted key=AIzaSy carve-out is preserved per spec 5.1.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: 63 added is essentially the persistence-rejector implementation in json_io (~52 lines for the new exception class, the 6-domain tuple, three helper functions, and the two wire-up call-sites). The two path edits in fetch-images-batch.py are exactly 2 lines and the mcp_client changes are minimal (smaller after collapsing the docstring to fit the quality-gate function-length budget). The new helpers are split into small functions (one per concern) specifically because the pretool-quality-gate hook caps function length at 30 lines and nesting depth at 3.
